steps.title: Multiply by the Trigonometric Conjugate
steps.explanation: Multiply numerator and denominator by 1 + cos(x).
steps.why: Conjugate multiplication allows applying the Pythagorean identity.

steps.title: Apply Pythagorean Identity
steps.mathExpression: 1 - \cos^2 x = \sin^2 x \implies \frac{\sin^2 x}{x^2(1 + \cos x)} = \left(\frac{\sin x}{x}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{1}{1 + \cos x}
steps.explanation: Replace 1 - cos^2(x) with sin^2(x) and group terms.

steps.title: Evaluate Using Limit Laws
steps.explanation: Apply product rule of limits and the fundamental limit lim_{x->0} sin(x)/x = 1.
steps.why: Cosine is continuous at 0 with cos(0) = 1.
